purpose: Controlled investigation of missing-topology adaptation and modality contributions; preserve original results.
graph_seed_formula: 20260930 + fold (fixed across model repeats and model families)

validation_grid.selection: per condition-family-fold: minimum best validation BCE, ties choose lower LR
validation_grid.test_access: none in training/selection; test pair IDs only for graph leakage audit

selected_repeats.learning_rate: freeze repeat-0 selected LR separately for each condition-family-fold; no retuning

evaluation.metric_display: AUPR = trapezoidal PR curve area; Average Precision stored separately
evaluation.comparison: same test pairs, fold, model repeat and graph representation
evaluation.test_status: Existing benchmark was previously examined and motivated this change. These are adaptive same-benchmark comparisons, not a new blind or independent external evaluation.

capacity_control.visibility: retain numerical results and verification; existing figures/manuscript not edited

source_policy: Original core files, prepared benchmark, source sequences, previous runs, figures and manuscripts are read-only. New code and artifacts only.
pilot: Run one protein-disjoint fold before full campaign; verify masks, finite training, checkpoint restore and IDs. Pilot runs meeting the final contract may be reused within this campaign.
acceptance: Completed jobs, independent numerical/provenance verification and a source-backed report, regardless of whether the proposed repairs improve performance.
